contexts.text: Jehovah came down () = judgment upon them... To come down, relatively to Jehovah, is predicated when judgment takes place...
To come down is predicated of Jehovah, because most high is predicated of Him... Illustrated.
Come, let us go down () = judgment so done.
I will go down I pray, and I will see () = visitation. To go down to see = judgment; thus, it = visitation...
To descend cannot be predicated of the Lord, because He is always in the highest...
Afterwards, I saw represented by them the descent of the Lord to the bound... HH 335:2.
Let him not come down to take them away () = to turn himself away from good to truth.
To go down into the plain () = the doctrinal things which are of the Rational.
Hence it is that to ascend is predicated towards Jerusalem, but to descend from Jerusalem.

Therefore it is here first said that the affection of truth, which is represented by Rebekah, went down to the fountain, and presently, that it went up (); for Divine love inflows into the affection of good, and thence into the affection of truth, and vivifies and enlightens those things which are in the natural man, and then disposes them into order; this is signified by to descend.
Under Ascend, see this reference, and at AC 3702. AC 3882:2. AC 4009. AC 4042. AC 5406. AC 5492:end. HH 35. DLord 35:11. DLW 199. DLW 218. CL 302.
The natural mind is that through which... the things of the Lord inflow and descend into nature, and through the same mind those things which are of nature ascend.
Descent is nothing else than from good to behold truth, as from a mountain...

As the Word is from the Lord, and descends from Him through Heaven to man, it is Divine as to every single thing; and, as it has descended from the Lord, so it ascends, that is, is elevated to Him, and this through the Heavens... Wherefore, when the Word ascends as it descends, in the Lord it is Divine, in the Third Heaven it is celestial...
I will go down to the grave to my son mourning () = that the Ancient Church would perish.

Therefore it was said to descend from Zion and Jerusalem towards the boundaries, but from the boundaries to Jerusalem and Zion, to ascend. Hence it is, that to ascend involves elevation to truth and good, and to descend, casting down to falsity and evil... Hence it is here said, that Judah went down from his brethren (). AC 4816.
(Joseph) was made to go down to Egypt () = to the scientifics which are of the Church. Explained.

Who made him go down thither () = from that good to these scientifics... It is said to go down, because it treats of scientifics, which are exterior things; for in the Word to go from interior to exterior things is called going down, but from exterior to interior things, going up.
Go down thither, and buy for us from thence () = appropriation thereby; (for) to go down is predicated of going towards exterior things.

My son shall not go down with you () = that he will not let himself down to lower things. To go down is predicated of going towards lower things; here, to the scientific truths which are in the interior Natural.
That this truth of good should be conjoined with him, is signified by their causing him (Benjamin) to go down ().
They rose up and went down to Egypt () = elevation to procure themselves life from the interior things of scientifics... To go down = to procure themselves life. Explained.

Coming down we came down at the beginning to buy food () = the disposition of procuring good for truths... To come down = the disposition or intention; for he who comes down, or betakes himself anywhere, does it with a disposition.
Other silver we cause to come down in our hand () = that there is a disposition to procure good elsewhere by means of truth... To cause to come down = a disposition to procure.
Cause him to come down unto me () = that this new truth should be subjected to internal good. Explained.

Ye will make my grey hair to go down in evil to the grave () = that spiritual good would perish, and thus the internal of the Church... To go down in good into the grave = to rise again, and to be regenerated; therefore to go down in evil into the grave, is the opposite, thus to perish.
Lest they descend from good, and look backwards... is signified by he who is upon the house, let him not go down to take anything out of the house...
Come down unto me, tarry not () = sure conjunction. To come down, or, to come to me, = conjunction.

Fear not to go down into Egypt () = that natural truth, with all things belonging to it, must be initiated into the scientifics of the Church... To go down = to be initiated; for, in order that this initiation might be represented, Jacob with all that belonged to him went down into Egypt.
To go down into Egypt = to initiate truth, and to gather them into the scientifics of the Church.
They are called fathers, because from them the Church has descended...

As to each and all things, the Word has descended from the Lord... In its descent it has clothed itself with forms adapted to apprehension in the three Heavens, and at last with a form for the apprehension of man...
Under Deliver, see this reference.
With the Lord's descending, the case is this...
This is what is meant by the descent of the Lord to the inhabitants of the infernal regions. AC 8018.
All thy servants shall come down unto me () = those who are subordinate.
From the (time of the) descent of Jacob into Egypt...
They went down into the deeps as a stone () = that they fell to lower things as by their weight.

Jehovah will come down to the eyes of all the people () = the Advent of the Lord, and then enlightenment. To come down, when said of Jehovah, that is, the Lord, = His presence by means of influx, thus His Advent. Here the Advent of the Lord is meant by the descent of Jehovah to the eyes of all the people...

Moses came down from the mountain to the people () = application and preparation by means of truth from the Divine to receive truths in good. To come down, when said of Moses, = application, and also preparation thereby.
The descent of Jehovah upon Mount Sinai = His presence in Heaven. AC 8826.
Away and go down () = influx.
When truth Divine descends through the Heavens to men, as the Word has descended, it is accommodated on the way to all in Heaven and on earth.
In order that they might know that the Word was from the Divine through Heaven, the Lord Himself willed to descend, and promulgate the ten commandments with a living voice...
Then the spiritual man descends, that is, thinks in the natural.
That went down upon the mouth of his garments ()... To go down = influx.
All things which are of light from the Divine descend even to the ultimate ends...
To go down to take something out of the house = a return to the former state.
To delay to come down (), when said of the apperception of Divine truth from the Word, = not to flow in; for the Divine truth which inflows with man is said to descend from Heaven.
The difference between the elevation to a state of loves with the good, and with the evil, is that the good then ascend, and the evil descend. Explained.

Go, get thee down () = a looking into their external. To go down from Mount Sinai = to look into, review, and examine; for Mount Sinai = Heaven, from which is Divine truth; and to descend thence, in the spiritual sense, is not to descend with the body, but with the mind, thus it is to look into and review.
And Moses looked back and went down from the Mount () = the Word let down from Heaven. To look back and go down, when said of the Word, = to be let down.
Make thine ornament to descend from upon thee () = the quality of their external without the Divine... To make it descend from upon them = to put it off, thus to be without it.
It came to pass as Moses descended from Mount Sinai () = the influx of the internal into the external of the Word, of the Church, and of worship.
This love increases in descending...
The holy city descending from God out of Heaven = its heavenly doctrine revealed by the Lord. AR 879.
It thence descends into the body...
Whatever descends from the spiritual man into the body, presents itself there under a different appearance.
These ascending and descending degrees... DLW 274.
This truth on the way in its descent was by degrees turned into falsity... (TCR 135).
Which cometh down out of Heaven from my God () = which will be of the Lord's Divine truth, such as it is in Heaven.
I saw another mighty Angel coming down from Heaven () = the Lord in Divine majesty and power.
Because the devil hath come down to you, having great anger () = to those who are in the World of Spirits; and as these are in conjunction with the men of the Earth, it also = to such in the Earth.
An Angel coming down from Heaven () = the influx of the Lord out of Heaven.
I saw two Angels descending from Heaven... TCR 386.
It is said (of the holy city) coming down from God out of Heaven, because from the Lord through the New Christian Heaven.
The Angels said, Let us descend...
In the descent into the body...
The love for little children descends, and does not ascend. General article.
Jehovah descended and assumed the Human... TCR 3. TCR 82. TCR 838.
Man thus prepares the way by which God descends and elevates him.
They then descended; and as they descended the love of evil returned...
As he descended, forgetfulness expelled recollection... and he became as insane as ever.
That Jehovah God descended as Divine truth... TCR 86. TCR 88. CanonsNC 15. Redeemer 2.
As God descended...
By being sent into the world is meant to descend...
Then, by command of the Lord, there descended three Angels from Heaven...
The Word in its bosom is spiritual, because it descended from Jehovah, and passed through the angelic Heavens...
The Lord Himself does not descend, but an Angel...
He came down from Heaven with the Divine. Illustrated.
As this New Heaven... grows, so from that Heaven descends the New Jerusalem...
Now, when the New Church is commencing, or when the New Jerusalem is descending from Heaven.

Its descending upon the mouth of his garments = that thence is all the good and delight of Heaven from inmosts to ultimates... By to descend upon the mouth of the garments is signified the influx and conjunction of celestial good and spiritual good.
As the dew of Hermon which descended upon the mountains of Zion = the conjunction of truth and good.
The Last Judgment is meant by Jehovah... cometh down ().
